members.name: value
members.doc: The document, when the application controls it. The editor normalizes it, and an edit reports through `onChange`.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The first document, when the editor manages its own. It is normalized: a value that is not a document, or has nothing left after normalizing, becomes one empty paragraph.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the normalized document after an edit the editor accepts. It does not run at mount, when `disabled` or `readOnly` changes, or when `value` changes from outside.

members.name: label
members.doc: The visible label, which names the editable content.

members.name: description
members.doc: Help text below the content, which describes it.

members.name: errorMessage
members.doc: The error text below the content. Setting it also marks the content invalid and names the text as its error message.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the editor and its toolbar.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Keeps the content readable but not editable.

members.name: required
members.doc: Marks the content required.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Marks the content invalid.

members.name: placeholder
members.doc: The text shown while the document is empty.

members.name: limit
members.doc: The most characters of plain text the document may hold; a fraction is rounded down, and a negative, infinite, or omitted limit means no limit. An edit past it is refused and not reported.

members.name: toolbar
members.doc: `simple` or `advanced` shows that toolbar, `floating` shows the simple one as a floating bar, and `false` shows none.

members.name: floating
members.doc: Floats the toolbar over the content.

members.name: bubbleMenu
members.doc: Shows a formatting menu while text is selected.

members.name: onLinkRequest
members.doc: Called instead of the link prompt, with the actions that apply the address.

members.name: onImageRequest
members.type: (actions: { insertImage(src: string, alt?: string): boolean }) => void
members.doc: Called instead of the image prompt, with the action that inserts the image.

members.name: onColorRequest
members.doc: Called instead of applying a picked color, with the action that applies it.

members.name: onGenerate
members.doc: Called by the Generate with AI action. Returning `false` reports that nothing happened.

members.name: selectionActions
members.doc: Actions in the selection bar. Enabled with `onSelectionRequest`.

members.name: selectionInstruction
members.doc: Shows the "Describe edits" field in the selection bar. Defaults to true.

members.name: onSelectionRequest
members.doc:
Called when an action or instruction is sent. A returned promise shows the pending state; a rejection shows
a failure message with Try again and Dismiss.

exports.name: isTextEditorDocument
exports.doc: True for Mux's finite portable editor document grammar.

members.name: selection
members.type: { readonly text: string; readonly document: TextEditorDocument }
members.doc: The selected text and content when the request started.

members.name: signal
members.doc: Aborts on Escape or Cancel, an edit or formatting change of the selected range, a new request, `close()`, and unmount.

members.name: replace
members.doc:
Replaces the selection and starts the Keep, Discard, and Try again review.
A string is plain text that takes the formatting at the start of the selection and turns line breaks into
hard breaks; a document keeps its own formatting. Only the first successful edit of a request applies.
Returns false when the request is stale or aborted, the editor is disabled or read-only, `limit` would be
exceeded, or the content is invalid.

members.name: insertAfter
members.doc:
Like `replace`, but leaves the selection in place. A string is inserted right after the selection with the
formatting at the start of the selection; a document is inserted as blocks after the block that holds the end
of the selection.

members.name: close
members.doc: Ends the request and hides the bar until the selection changes, keeping any applied edit.
